# MedGrow AI Solutions

> MedGrow AI Solutions builds connected patient growth systems for medical practices — medical clinics, med spas and aesthetic clinics, dental practices and plastic surgery practices. Services: medical SEO, AEO & GEO (visibility in AI search such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Overviews), paid advertising (Google & Meta), website and landing page design, and instant follow-up with CRM and a live dashboard — built into the practice's existing tools. Positioning: "Found. Chosen. Booked."

For the complete text of the main pages, case studies and articles in one file, see [/llms-full.txt](https://www.codesquad.ai/llms-full.txt).

## Company

- [Home](https://www.codesquad.ai/): Overview of the patient growth system, services, specialties served, case studies and insights.
- [Found. Chosen. Booked.](https://www.codesquad.ai/fcb): The method — the three stages between a patient search and a booked appointment, the Clinic Transformation Guarantee, the Build + Growth Retainer engagement model, case studies and articles.
- [How the process works](https://www.codesquad.ai/process): The one-time Build phase followed by a monthly Grow retainer, with the detailed clinic flows (campaigns, messaging, CRM, Google Business Profile).
- [Founder — Shahzaib Hamid](https://www.codesquad.ai/founder): Founder & CEO profile — PhD in Applied AI, clinical gait-analysis research (IEEE Access 2024, ICT Express 2026).
- [Work with us](https://www.codesquad.ai/work-with-us): Application form for medical practices; replies usually within one business day.

## Services

- [All services](https://www.codesquad.ai/services): Services grouped by stage — Found, Chosen, Booked.
- [Medical SEO](https://www.codesquad.ai/services/seo): Google Business Profile and local SEO, treatment pages, patient-question content, technical health and reporting tied to enquiries.
- [AEO & GEO](https://www.codesquad.ai/services/aeo-geo): Answer-ready content, entity and credential signals, structured data and AI visibility checks so AI assistants can find, trust and cite a practice.
- [Paid advertising](https://www.codesquad.ai/services/paid-ads): Treatment-based Google Search and Meta campaigns, a landing page per campaign, policy-aware setup and spend linked to enquiries.
- [Website & landing page design](https://www.codesquad.ai/services/website-design): Treatment landing pages with trust signals, clear booking paths, speed and mobile performance, structured for SEO, AEO and GEO.
- [Instant follow-up, nurture & CRM](https://www.codesquad.ai/services/follow-up-crm): Instant text and email reply with a booking link, 14-day nurture, past-patient reactivation, CRM pipeline and one live dashboard.

## Specialties

- [Industries overview](https://www.codesquad.ai/industry): The four medical audiences served and how the system adapts to each.
- [Med spas & aesthetic clinics](https://www.codesquad.ai/aesthetics): Treatment-based Google Ads, 60-second lead response, 14-day automated nurture, SEO/AEO/GEO content and booking.
- [Medical clinics & dental](https://www.codesquad.ai/clinics): Local search, instant follow-up and booking for small medical clinics and dental practices.
- [Dental practices](https://www.codesquad.ai/dental): Treatment-specific campaigns and pages, automated response and 14-day follow-up, local and AI visibility.
- [Plastic surgery practices](https://www.codesquad.ai/plastic-surgery): AEO & GEO, procedure-focused advertising and long-cycle nurture for patients who research for months.

## Case studies

- [All case studies](https://www.codesquad.ai/case-studies): Results from medical practices, filterable by service.
- [Harmony MedSpa](https://www.codesquad.ai/case-studies/harmony-medspa-patient-growth-automation): 24/7 patient growth system — about 60-second lead response, 20+ hours a week saved on manual follow-up, 5-touch follow-up for non-bookers, past-patient reactivation, one dashboard.
- [CareInn Dental Clinic](https://www.codesquad.ai/case-studies/careinn-dental-clinic): Patient growth system live before the clinic's first patient — every enquiry answered within 60 seconds and followed up over 14 days.
- [RTM Kinetics](https://www.codesquad.ai/case-studies/rtm-kinetics): Patient CRM from first enquiry to recovery for remote therapeutic monitoring, with automated reconnect campaigns.
